messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: - Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in this medicine. There is a list of ingredients in this medicine, at the bottom of this page.
- Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
- Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
- Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while taking this medicine, you should tell your doctor. There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy. Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part, call 1-844-524-0039, or visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has pregnancy exposure registry", "Zepbound pregnancy exposure registry"]

The relation 'has pregnancy exposure registry' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication is associated with a formal registry for monitoring outcomes in pregnant women exposed to the medication.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'may be listed on': The subject drug may result in the patient's name being included in the registry specified by the object entity.
C. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires use of': The subject drug requires patients to use the specified product or practice to ensure safety or effectiveness.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
